title: tbrowse
description: React component that draws a tree beside row-aligned data zones (labels, MSA, plug-in columns) from a flat node table, with serialisable controlled view state.

applied: all --tbrowse-* CSS custom properties on .tbrowse-root re-pointed at GBIF token values from gbifTheme(): background (bg1, surface, bg2), text (fg1, fg3, fg4), borders (border, table-border), branch colour (fg2), accent (primary green: selection, hover and row tints, highlight ring, search ring), danger, leaf leader lines (slate-200); the override is one CSS rule with higher specificity (.gbif-tb.tbrowse-root) injected by the adapter
dark theme: theme='dark' prop plus the same variables from gbifDarkTheme() (derived from tokens, GBIF has no dark set)
font: root font-family = --font-body (Rubik); the library zones inherit it, our own label and column zones use it, tip labels are italic
row density through the rowHeight prop / ViewState.rowHeight (16 px demo default); text hidden below 9 px rows in our own zones
clade colours (categorical palette from the shell) on tree branches and leaf dots by inline-style DOM patching, plus colour in our label and column zones (text, left bar, data bars)
bar columns in the periwinkle categorical colour; hover, selection and highlight tints from --color-primary through color-mix()
runner tokens (background, foreground, branch, highlight, fontFamily) map onto --tbrowse-bg/text/branch/accent and font-family
customisation by hiding features through supported options: showHeader=false (toolbar and wordmark), zone visibility in ViewState, showLeafExtensions=false, autoCompressLongBranches
not_possible: node selection marker colour (hard-coded amber #f59e0b) and radius

branch width (fixed 1 to 3 px by clade size), leaf and node glyph sizes and shapes (circle or square by eventType), collapsed-triangle fill (fixed grey rgba), pruned-stub colours: constants in the source, no props
per-node or per-branch style callbacks: none; clade colouring is a DOM patch on the SVG (internal-node glyphs and dashed leaders stay grey)
MSA residue colours (canvas, hard-coded biology palettes) and MSA canvas text: cannot take tokens; only the schemes plain, clustal, hydrophobicity, nucleotide
the TBrowse wordmark in the toolbar (library branding): removable only by hiding the whole toolbar, which also removes the search box and zone toggles
toolbar, tooltip and button geometry (inline px styles, radii, 12 px sizes); font size only through the single fontSize prop
tooltip hover chrome in the tree zone is drawn by the library with its own layout; the shell's hover tooltip is separate
styling.notes: Theming is the library's strongest point: every colour that is not a constant goes through a --tbrowse-* variable, so a token mapping is one CSS rule. What is a constant in the source (selection, glyphs, widths, residues) cannot be restyled without a fork.
